review_notes: I read the whole file. It has two theorems (`toTypes_isSheaf`, `toType_isSheaf`) and two bundling defs (`sheafToTypes`, `sheafToType`). It has no simp lemmas, no simp attributes and no simp-based rewriting. I grepped the repository for uses of `sheafToTypes` and `sheafToType`. The only real use is `(sheafToTypes X T).existsUnique_gluing` in LocalPredicate.lean, which needs no simp lemma. The `.obj` and `.map` simp lemmas for the underlying presheaves already sit next to `presheafToTypes` and `presheafToType` in PresheafOfFunctions.lean. The theorems are `Prop`-valued sheaf proofs, so they have no simp normal form. I found no use that a `@[simps]` or `.presheaf` projection lemma for the two sheaf defs would help, so I recommend no change. I did not run Lean.
